subject: phone in rice
title: What If You Put Your Wet Phone in Rice?

scenes.text: What if you dropped your phone in water and buried it in rice? Apple says don't.
Rice can't pull water out of a phone's insides. It only touches the outside.
In a 2014 test of seven drying materials, uncooked rice came dead last.
And every one of them lost to plain open air.
Worse, tiny bits of rice and starch dust can get stuck in the charging port.
Apple's advice: tap it, port down, let it air-dry, and wait up to a day to charge. The rice only made you feel better.

description:
Apple's support guidance says not to put a wet iPhone in a bag of rice because small particles can damage it; instead tap it gently with the connector facing down and leave it to dry, waiting up to 24 hours before charging.
In a 2014 Gazelle test of seven materials, uncooked rice dried worst, and open air beat them all.
